4. Explore the Readings tab for a deeper look at your birth chart.

After that, open the Home tab for your first daily horoscope, explore the Readings tab for deeper insights, and use the Experts tab to browse experts and book a session when you are ready for personal guidance.

Best regards,
[Agent name]
drafts.empathetic:

When the app crashes on launch or won't open at all, a few basic steps resolve most cases.

1. Update the app: open the App Store or Google Play, check for a pending update for the app, and install it.
2. Restart your device: a full restart clears temporary issues that simply closing the app doesn't.
3. Reopen the app and confirm whether the crash still happens.
4. Reinstall the app: uninstall it, then reinstall from the App Store or Google Play.

3. Reopen the app to confirm whether the crash still happens.
4. If it still will not open, reinstall the app by uninstalling it and reinstalling from the App Store or Google Play.

If the app still will not open after updating, restarting, and reinstalling, contact support from a browser or another device (since the app itself will not open) via Profile → Help → Contact support on the web. Include your device model, operating system version, and when the crashes started.

- If it still crashes, uninstall the app and reinstall it from the App Store or Google Play.

If it still does not open after that, please contact support using the web version of Profile → Help → Contact support from a browser or another device, and include your device model, operating system version, and when the crashes started.

kb_quote: Failed payments: if a renewal or session payment fails, for example because of an expired card, we retry the charge automatically for up to 3 days. During this time your Premium access continues. If all retries fail, Premium access ends and the subscription is marked as unpaid; update your payment method and resubscribe from Profile → Subscription to restore access.

drafts.formal:
Hello [Customer name],

To turn off your daily horoscope push notifications, open the app and go to Profile → Notifications. Toggle “Daily horoscope” off. If you still receive notifications after turning it off, check that notifications for the app are allowed in your device settings.

You can also adjust the delivery time from the same notifications screen by tapping “Daily horoscope time” (8:00 AM by default in your device’s local time).

Best regards,
[Agent name]
